questions.question: Which comment is most useful?
options: # The API counts pages from 1, not 0
questions.explanation: Good comments explain WHY: things the code itself can't show.

questions.question: A function "loads the file and cleans the data and draws a chart". What should you do?
options: Split it into smaller functions that each do one thing
questions.explanation: Small single-purpose functions are easier to name, test, reuse and debug.
